test_title: PYST 27: Selection Post (Graduate Level) - English Language (Held On 30 Jul, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Find the part of the sentence that contains an error:

The audible protest (1)/ by the silent demonstrator (2)/ confused the officials (3)/ and media alike. (4)
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The error lies in **part (2)** of the sentence due to a **logical contradiction** (oxymoron) and a potential issue with the **article**.
 
• An "**audible protest**" is one that can be heard (shouting, chanting, etc.), which contradicts the description of the "**silent demonstrator**.&
